**Pre-release for testing — not a stable version.** Clean-room Rust post-processor for scanned books: split → deskew → crop → clean/binarize → PDF with an OCR text layer. GUI in 8 languages (ro, en, fr, it, es, pt, de, hu) and command line. MIT licence, runs locally, no accounts.

## Downloads
Pick the archive for your system; every archive has a `.sha256` next to it.

| System | File | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Linux x86-64 / ARM64 | `*-linux-gnu.tar.gz` | glibc 2.35 or newer (Ubuntu 22.04, Debian 12 and later); OpenGL 2+, X11 or Wayland |
| Windows x86-64 | `*-windows-msvc.zip` | no Visual C++ Redistributable needed; OpenGL 2+ |
| macOS Apple-silicon / Intel | `*-apple-darwin.zip` | unsigned: right-click → Open on first launch |

OCR works out of the box with the built-in engine; Tesseract is used instead when it is installed with the languages you ask for (`--engine auto`, the default).

## New since 0.2.0-pre.5
- **Whole-project adversarial review, second round.** Hardening of the PDF reader (bounded graphics-state stack, ToUnicode targets, unterminated strings, JBIG2 symbol lists, CCITT resynchronisation and stalled rows, stale stream index), XMP metadata with control characters, native OCR model files (channel caps, non-finite weights), OCR subprocess time limits, clobber guards for outputs, project reopen fixes in the GUI.
- **Encrypted packages:** `--package-password-file` makes a `.zip` package with WinZip AES-256 (opens in 7-Zip, WinZip, Keka); output-name templates `{date} {year} {month} {day} {name}`; checksums files merge instead of overwriting.
- **Audit / retention log:** `--audit-log FILE` appends a JSON Lines record per file written (time, version, inputs, SHA-256, size) with `--retain-until YYYY-MM-DD` and `--legal-hold`. It records evidence; it deletes nothing.
- **Rotation in 45° steps** per sheet in the GUI (↺45° / ↻45°), on top of the 90° buttons – suggested by a tester.
- **Cleaner text layer in the PDF:** the invisible OCR text is now written one text object per recognised line, with one baseline and one font size per line (as ABBYY does), so selecting and copying follows the lines instead of scattering over differently sized words.
- **Dewarp with guide lines:** `--dewarp-guide "X,Y X,Y …"` straightens the line you point out (also a GUI field and saved in the project). **Word export with tables:** aligned columns on three or more rows become a real Word table (cell text is the recognised words, nothing invented).
- Carried over from the Workshop recommendations: `--json`, `--search-preset`, wildcards and `NEAR` in `--search`.

## Known limits
- Dewarp guides can be drawn with the mouse (GUI drawing not visually tested); Word export has tables and column sections; JBIG2 Huffman is decoded natively (no refinement/aggregation in Huffman mode).
- The native OCR engine has only been validated on synthetic pages (see above); no real-scan accuracy claim is made.
- PDF/A-2b is checked with veraPDF on generated samples only; it is not a certification of every output.
- JBIG2 Huffman refinement/aggregation and some JPEG 2000 code-block styles are decoded only through an installed `pdftoppm`, `mutool` or Ghostscript.
- Only the empty user password is tried on encrypted PDFs. Very faint pencil pages can count as blank.
- 7z and rar archives were NOT tested (no extractor was available to the author). Verified by hand on Linux x86-64 only; the Windows, macOS and ARM64 builds come from CI. The GUI was smoke-tested, not exercised in depth.

Documentation and presentation: https://legatorocr.chiuta.ro · Source and comparison with other tools: README.md, COMPARISON.md.

## Hardening before this build
An adversarial review of the new code (JBIG2 Huffman, dewarp guides and their GUI, Word columns and tables, checksums, audit log, PDF text layer) found and fixed: unbounded memory/CPU on hostile JBIG2 streams, reserved Huffman selections decoded as garbage, near-vertical strokes accepted as dewarp guides, guide edits missing from Undo/Reset/Clear, blank pages after Word column sections, prose columns turned into tables (and tables into columns), `SHA256SUMS` empty for a bare `out.pdf` and mishandling odd file names, page images missing from the audit log, control characters and off-page baselines in the PDF text layer.
